title: Palak Paneer Spinach Cottage Cheese

description: Palak Paneer is a beloved Indian vegetarian dish featuring tender cubes of paneer, an Indian cottage cheese, simmered in a vibrant, creamy spinach gravy. This wholesome curry is bursting with fresh flavors from ginger, garlic, and aromatic spices, offering a delightful balance of earthy and rich tastes. It's a comforting and nutritious meal, perfect for a family dinner or special occasion.

instructions.title: Prepare the Spinach
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the cleaned spinach and blanch for 2-3 minutes until wilted. Immediately transfer the blanched spinach to an ice bath to stop cooking and retain its vibrant green color. Once cooled, drain well and blend into a smooth puree with the green chilies. Set aside.

instructions.title: Fry the Paneer (Optional)
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil or ghee in a pan over medium heat. Lightly fry the paneer cubes until golden brown on all sides. This adds flavor and prevents the paneer from crumbling. Remove and set aside. If you prefer softer paneer, you can skip frying and add it directly later, or soak fried paneer in warm water for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: In the same pan, add the remaining oil or ghee. Once hot, add the cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn translucent and light golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the ginger garlic paste and cook for another minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Add Tomatoes and Spices
instructions.text: Pour in the tomato puree. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture thickens and the oil starts to separate from the sides, about 3-5 minutes. Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well and cook for another minute.

instructions.title: Combine with Spinach and Paneer
instructions.text: Add the spinach puree to the onion-tomato mixture. Mix thoroughly and bring to a gentle simmer. If the gravy is too thick, add about 1/4 cup of water to reach your desired consistency. Stir in the fried paneer cubes, garam masala, and crushed Kasuri Methi. Cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. If desired, swirl in fresh cream for extra richness and garnish. Serve hot with naan, roti, paratha, or basmati rice. Enjoy your homemade Palak Paneer!

tips: To prevent spinach from losing its bright green color, always blanch it briefly and then immediately shock it in ice-cold water before pureeing.
For extra creamy Palak Paneer without adding too much cream, you can add 1-2 tablespoons of cashew paste or a small piece of boiled potato to the spinach while blending.
If your paneer is a bit hard, soak it in warm water for 10-15 minutes before frying or adding to the gravy to make it softer and more tender.
